# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** sailor and store clerk  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Rufus was a large, good-looking man who belonged to the slim sort before his death. He possessed a high color in his cheeks, pale hair, and the Vane family characteristic of having one blue eye and one hazel eye.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Rufus possessed a small, wicked soul and was persistent in pursuing things until he obtained them, after which he lost interest. Though generally pleasant and amiable when matters went well, he was a heavy drinker and harbored a strong personal hostility toward Winifred Tolley.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c30 P44](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0044)_

## Goals

- marry Lorna West  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## History

Rufus Vane spent his winters working as a clerk in his father Abner's store at the Glen and his summers sailing. He pursued Lorna West relentlessly due to her beauty and her initial refusals to speak to him. After her mother nagged her into agreeing, Lorna married him. Following their marriage, they settled on the Ainslie place for the winter. Growing tired of peaceful domestic life, Rufus departed the next spring aboard the vessel Four Sisters with his double cousin, Laurence Vane, bound for Havana. While in Cuba, Rufus contracted yellow fever and died thirteen years prior to the discovery of his fate, while Laurence stayed behind to care for him. For twelve years, the people of Seven Gulls mistaken his surviving cousin Laurence—who had lost his memory in a drunken brawl—for Rufus.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_
